ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows a north-south trending coastline on the west coast of a continent, with the ocean on the left marked "Pacific Ocean," "land" on the right, and a mountain/highland belt near the coast; the figure has latitude lines such as 10°, 20°, and 30° marked, and location ① is located in the offshore sea area on the west coast of this continent. Then reason: Based on the west coast of the continent, the Pacific Ocean side, and the coastal mountain and highland belt, it can be judged that this is the Peru-Chile coastal sea area of South America. This sea area is affected by the Peru Cold Current; the cold current cools the nearshore air and makes the stratification stable, and water vapor easily condenses to form fog. Therefore, the weather characteristic of the sea area at ① is foggy.

method.method_draft: 先读图确定①在南半球低纬到副热带大陆西岸近海，并结合海岸线、山地高原带判断为南美洲秘鲁—智利沿岸海域。然后调用区域地理知识：该海域有秘鲁寒流流经，寒流使近海空气降温、稳定，水汽易凝结成雾。由此填写“多雾”。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中显示一段南北走向的大陆西岸海岸线，左侧为海洋并标注“太平洋”，右侧为“陆地”，沿海岸附近有山脉/高原带；图上有10°、20°、30°等纬线标注，①处位于该大陆西岸近海海域。再推理：根据大陆西岸、太平洋一侧以及沿岸山地高原带，可判断这是南美洲秘鲁—智利沿岸海域。该海域受秘鲁寒流影响，寒流使近海空气降温、层结稳定，水汽容易凝结形成雾，因此①处海域的天气特征是多雾。
